method: Actual shipped costs, durations, grant, financing and service patterns. Default starter operated during real construction months. Baseline existing public services optimized first among all service-stop pairs, mirrored into project world; add or extend one connector through service. Fixed first-post-opening fare/frequency chosen from bounded grid, then settle 12 months. Monthly cash deltas include maintenance and actual loan interest, exclude upfront capital/principal repayment and competition. A greedy portfolio screen, not an optimum or campaign NPV.
